label: Springs and the zero-force target
subgoals: Write each connection as a spring force proportional to distance
Sum the forces on the cell
Solve for the weighted centroid where the force vanishes

label: Net force on a cell
subgoals: Evaluate the spring force sum at the current position
Read the sign as the pull direction
Add a density force to stop collapse to the centre

label: The ripple-move algorithm
subgoals: Round the zero-force target to the nearest grid slot
Displace the occupant and ripple it to its own target
Stop the ripple with an abort rule
